name: oafish
description: Output compression for AI coding agents

scripts.build: bun build hooks/src/activate.ts hooks/src/tracker.ts hooks/src/compress.ts hooks/src/compress-file.ts hooks/src/mcp-shrink.ts --outdir hooks/dist --target node --format cjs
scripts.publish:patch: npm version patch && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:minor: npm version minor && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:major: npm version major && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --access public
